name: timebox
description: Bound agent work with Available Work Time, Closeout Grace Period, and a hard stop.

interface.shortDescription: AWT and CGP execution for agent work
interface.longDescription: Run an authorized task inside a fixed Available Work Time window, reserve a shorter Closeout Grace Period for convergence only, and report honestly at the hard stop.
defaultPrompt: Use the timebox skill with the AWT and CGP I provide to complete this task by the hard stop.
